message.content:
The query below returns the districts that have at least one shop selling fewer than 3,000 products and at least one shop selling more than 10,000 products.

FINAL SQL:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT s1.District
FROM shop s1
JOIN shop s2 ON s1.District = s2.District
WHERE s1.Number_products < 3000
  AND s2.Number_products > 10000;
```
